title: The column-role student's sealed exam on real tables: failed on precision by half a point
request: The owner's step 2: give the role student that reached 99.7% on real dev columns its sealed exam on real tables.
spec: decision_gate_v1 (thresholds fixed before any run); real_v1's sealed partition (fingerprint committed 2026-10-19).
plan: Check the student against the gate's bars on dev rows.
Fix the scope before the read and commit it.

decisions.decision: Identifiers left out of the scope, decided on dev rows and committed before the read (98d6cec6).
decisions.why: 6 of 3,744 dev columns are identifiers and the student found none; DCLab asks column.is_identifier first.

decisions.decision: No second read and no change to the gate after the result.
decisions.why: A sealed set is read once; a gate changed after its result is no gate.

change: dclab_rnd/decision_gate_run.py (the real set, --exclude with a required --why), evidence DMG-014, the plan

findings.defect: The pre-read check missed the gate's precision definition.
findings.scenario: DMG-014: precision lower bound 0.7953 under 0.80; every other criterion passed.
findings.cause: The gate averages precision over the classes the student answered; the student still answered identifier on a few non-identifier columns, a class with no truth in the scope. The check averaged over the true classes only.
findings.fix: Next: restrict the student's options to the scope's classes when asked inside it; check with the gate's own function before any read.

measurements.name: DMG-014
measurements.result: fail: accuracy 99.2% (lower 98.6%), rule 83.8%, margin >= 10.5 points, recall 97.3%, precision 79.85% (lower 79.53% < 0.80)
limits: the tables' declarations are their uploaders'

outcome: The role student is far more accurate than the rule on sealed real tables but fails the gate on precision; it stays in shadow.
lessons: Check a candidate with the gate's own function before reading a sealed set: a near-copy of the metric can differ in what it averages over.
risks: A fresh sealed set needs new real tables.
